decision.next_step_detail: The four contrast-relation-model defects in phase_9.shared_substrate_note are the next target, in that order of measured cost: silence-as-defeat (3 items), competitor independence (3 items), anchor typing (2 items), condition disjunction (1 item). None is an option-layer change and none should be bundled with another.

derivation: Stages were recomputed from the frozen artifacts by contrast_first_pilot.build_pilot_contrast_sets and run_post_stem_revalidation, not read from a narrative. Every count below is computed from those objects except the per-item PRIMARY_EARLIEST_CAUSE, the OPEN/CLOSED silence classification and the difficulty-failure classification, which are authored judgements and each carry the reviewer sentence or stem span they rest on.

phase_10_conditional_bounded_fix.reason: The rule's condition is not met and the diagnosis contradicts the fix's premise. Implementing PROVENANCE_LOCKED_OPTION_REALIZATION would lock what is already locked.
phase_10_conditional_bounded_fix.rule: Implement one bounded fix only if ONE option-layer root cause explains a clear plurality or majority of the eight rejected items.

phase_16_context_cost.removal_note: Identified only, as the task requires. Removing these fields edits the frozen contrast-matrix schema and would move the matrix content hash, which is out of scope for a diagnosis.
phase_16_context_cost.target_rationale: The contrast matrix is 5,708 characters at the median, 38 per cent of the 14,895-character total and the largest component by a wide margin; stem authoring is 510. Two matrix row fields are exact duplicates of two others in all 39 rows: SUPPORTING_FEATURES repeats SHARED_PLAUSIBILITY_FEATURES.stem_feature_ids, and DEFEATING_DISCRIMINATORS.unsatisfiable_conditions repeats the feature ids already in CORRECTNESS_CONDITIONS. That is 424 characters at the median, 7.2 per cent of the matrix and 2.8 per cent of the total.

counterfactual.question: Would every reject-forcing defect disappear if the option layer never asserted an unstated condition false and never mutated a cited claim?

G2-MED-03.rests_on: Furosemide and sublingual nitroglycerin are eliminated by one and the same preload proposition, so one option slot does no independent work. The paired troponin values have no role in the decision the lead-in asks for.
G2-MED-03.why_earliest: The two competitors were selected together at contrast-set assembly, and no predicate P1-P6 or validate_contrast_set rule tests whether two competitors are defeated by the same clinical proposition. SF-C21-TROPONIN-RISE-OR-FALL is a key correctness condition authored in the frozen contrast set, so the blueprint was obliged to require it PRESENT and the stem was obliged to state it.

G2-OBGYN-01.rests_on: Two unsupported rationale claims ... Stem, key and option set were all judged sound ... The defect is confined to the rationale text.
G2-OBGYN-01.why_earliest: CLM-R2-OB-ABSCESS says an abscess presents with progressive induration and erythema and OFTEN a palpable fluid collection; the key rationale renders that as the categorical inverse, 'A firm mass-like area without fluctuance is inflammation, not a drainable collection' (POLARIZED). CLM-R2-OB-MASTITIS-ANCHOR attaches the described presentation to INFLAMMATORY mastitis only; the key rationale renders it as defining 'inflammatory and bacterial mastitis' (BROADENED). Both mutations are authored at rationale realization; every distractor option text and both seed-derived rationale clauses are verbatim.

G2-PED-01.rests_on: The asymmetric reduced air entry was inserted to keep pneumonia and foreign body live and is then dismissed in the key rationale by a claim no cited packet supports.
G2-PED-01.why_earliest: SF-P147-FOCAL-ASYMMETRIC-FINDINGS is the only plausibility anchor available to SEED-PED-T01-FOREIGN-BODY once SF-P147-ABRUPT-ONSET-NO-PRODROME is forbidden, and it is also a correctness condition of both that seed and SEED-PED-T01-PNEUMONIA. Asserting it PRESENT is the only way to satisfy the anchor-density target and it necessarily makes two competitors partly correct on a stated positive that no claim in the item's evidence set can neutralize.

G2-PED-02.rests_on: The stem's own facts satisfy the guideline conditions the rationales say are unmet ... Not repairable by editing rationales.
G2-PED-02.why_earliest: CLM-R2-PED-VIRAL-INDICATION reads 'if required for infection control purposes, OR in high risk patients', and CLM-R2-PED-CXR-INDICATION reads 'unclear, ... not as expected OR severity'. Both are carried into CORRECTNESS_CONDITIONS as two predicates that _satisfied counts conjunctively, so a competitor whose first disjunct the stem states is scored 1 of 2 and treated as defeated. The key is additionally contradicted by its own cited CLM-R4-PED-CONTINUOUS, whose preconditions for intermittent monitoring the infant does not meet.

G2-PHELO-01.rests_on: Randomisation excludes healthy-screenee bias but not length bias or overdiagnosis, and the stem supplies no case-mix or case-count data to separate them from lead time.
G2-PHELO-01.why_earliest: The blueprint forbade SF-PH07-INDOLENT-VARIANT-OVERREPRESENTED and SF-PH07-MORE-CASES-DIAGNOSED-IN-SCREENED as PRESENT, which only removes them from the stem; it never assigns them ABSENT. _satisfied scores an unassigned feature as unsatisfied, so no_second_key passed while both competitors remained defensible on the realized stem.

G2-PSY-03.rests_on: The access barrier the blueprint inserted to defeat in-person psychotherapy is precisely the condition under which digital CBT is indicated, so it strengthens that competitor rather than weakening it, and the stem reports no patient preference.
G2-PSY-03.why_earliest: The blueprint required SF-PS12-PSYCHOTHERAPY-INACCESSIBLE-IN-PERSON PRESENT to defeat SEED-PSY-T03-PSYCHOTHERAPY. That feature is one of the two correctness conditions of SEED-PSY-T03-DIGITAL, whose other condition SF-PS12-PATIENT-PREFERS-PSYCHOTHERAPY the blueprint only forbade PRESENT rather than assigning ABSENT, so the stem is silent on a domain it never examined and digital CBT is left 1 of 2 satisfied and undefeated.

G2-SURG-01.rests_on: Pelvic inflammatory disease and tubo-ovarian abscess test the same discrimination, the latter being a complication of the former ... A lone-category cue is also present: the key is the only non-gynaecologic option.
G2-SURG-01.why_earliest: SEED-SURG-T01-PID and SEED-SURG-T01-TOA share the correctness condition SF-GS76-CERVICAL-MOTION-OR-ADNEXAL-TENDERNESS, and TOA is a complication of PID, so the pair is not independently discriminable. All three selected competitors realize exactly one plausibility anchor, SF-GS76-FEMALE-REPRODUCTIVE-AGE, a demographic fact. Both properties are fixed at contrast-set assembly, before any stem exists.

G2-SURG-02.rests_on: MRI and ultrasound-with-KUB have no positive stem anchor; and the pre-declared probability band, the contrast clearance and the availability clause are all present because options need them.
G2-SURG-02.why_earliest: SEED-SURG-T02-MRI and SEED-SURG-T02-KUB realize no anchor other than SF-GS76-IMAGING-AVAILABLE-NOW, a system-constraint fact that the frozen anchor layer counts as a plausibility anchor and a human reviewer does not. Both key correctness conditions, SF-GS76-INTERMEDIATE-CLINICAL-SUSPICION and SF-GS76-IMAGING-AVAILABLE-NOW, are meta-assertions rather than observable findings, so the blueprint could only require the stem to declare them. The Alvarado contradiction and the availability clause are downstream stem-realization consequences of that set.

phase_2_primary_earliest_cause.taxonomy_note: One primary per rejected item, the earliest stage carrying a defect that on its own forces REJECT under the reviewers' rule that any count above zero on the nine safety dimensions rejects. Downstream symptoms are not counted as separate primaries.

phase_3_concept_quality_versus_wording_q.finding: The provenance-locked-option hypothesis is falsified on its own terms: distractor realization is already lossless. Every one of the 32 realized distractor option texts, every Live clause and every correctness-condition clause is the frozen curated string verbatim. The only clinical claim the option layer authors for a distractor is the appended sentence 'That condition is not met here.', and that sentence is a faithful verbalisation of the blueprint solver's own semantics, in which an unassigned feature counts as unsatisfied. Locking what is already locked changes nothing.

semantic_mutation_during_realization.distractor_correctness_condition_clause: UNCHANGED in 32 of 32; one fixed sentence APPENDED in 32 of 32
semantic_mutation_during_realization.key_option_text: NARROWED in 3 of 10 (G2-PED-02, G2-PHELO-02, G2-SURG-02), each a shortening that removes no load-bearing semantics
semantic_mutation_during_realization.key_rationale: free-authored in 10 of 10; POLARIZED and BROADENED in G2-OBGYN-01, ADDED an unevidenced dismissal in G2-PED-01

phase_4_positive_controls.smallest_distinguishing_property: Not seed strength, not anchor count, not response-class or granularity parity, not cueing, and not option wording: all of those are uniform or present in both groups. The property that separates them is whether the stem's description is CLOSED over the domain of each competitor's unmet condition. Both accepted items sit at the cohort minimum of 0.67 silent conditions per competitor, and their silences fall in domains the stem enumerates exhaustively -- the contents of a letter, the region's staffing -- so silence is a real negation. In the rejected items the same silences fall in domains the stem never examined: no pelvic examination, no treatment preference, no case mix, no body habitus, no risk history. There the item asserts a negative it has not established.
phase_4_positive_controls.stated_limit: Two accepted controls cannot prove a property. No single measured property separates 2 from 8 without exception: G2-PHELO-03 was accepted while carrying one competitor defeated only by open silence. This is reported as the strongest measured association, not as a validated rule.

phase_5_option_realization_contract_audi.should_the_renderer_render_a_locked_conc: It should render a locked concept, and for distractors it already does. The unlocked surface is the key rationale, not the option set.

phase_6_provenance_locked_option_hypothe.hypothesis: OPTION REALIZATION SHOULD BE A LOSSLESS OR STRICTLY CONTROLLED RENDERING STEP
phase_6_provenance_locked_option_hypothe.reason: It is already lossless for the 32 realized distractors, and the one rejection it would have prevented is 1 of 8. The contract fields it proposes -- CONCEPT_ID, RESPONSE_CLASS, DECISION_GRANULARITY, SEMANTIC_SCOPE, EVIDENCE_IDS -- are all already carried and already uniform across every realized option set; the fields that are wrong are upstream, in the anchor and correctness-condition model the matrix projects.

phase_7_cue_and_parity_analysis.key_is_linguistically_privileged: Once, in G2-MED-03, where the key is the longest option. Elsewhere the key is shorter than the longest distractor. Length ratio is tighter in the two accepted sets (1.22, 1.78) than in six of the eight rejected sets, and the two rejected sets above the 3.0 threshold are exactly the two the production contract refused.

phase_8_difficulty_analysis.EASY_FAILURE_EXPLANATION: All five realized EASY items were rejected, and their primary causes are the same spread as the cohort (A 1, B 1, C 2, H 1), so there is no EASY-specific defect class. There is an EASY-specific exposure. REQUIRED_FEATURE_CAP gives EASY the smallest stem-feature budget and the realized EASY stems carry 2 to 4 required features, which is the fewest, so EASY stems leave the most competitor conditions unaddressed: 1.20 silent conditions per competitor against 1.06 at MEDIUM and 0.71 at HARD. The ladder's budget runs opposite to what safe discrimination needs, because closing a competitor's condition costs stem material.
phase_8_difficulty_analysis.HARD_DIFFICULTY_MISMATCH_EXPLANATION: G2-PHELO-03 was declared HARD and judged EASY because, in the reviewer's words, the capacity shortfall is stated so unambiguously and closed off so completely that little inference is left. That closure is exactly the property that made it one of the two safe items. Meanwhile MAXIMUM_ABSENT_REQUIRED_FEATURES is 0 at HARD, which forbids the explicit denials that would close a domain, pushing HARD items toward the open silence that produced the second keys. Under the current model an item is safe when its discriminator is closed and hard when it is not, and the architecture has no way to be both.

phase_9_root_cause_decision.shared_substrate_note: The seven non-option primaries are not seven unrelated problems. All seven are failure modes of one layer that the Phase 9 vocabulary has no name for: the contrast-relation model, meaning the frozen plausibility_anchor_feature_ids and condition_predicates over which the matrix, the blueprint solver and the anchor floor all reason. Its four measured defects are: (1) anchors are untyped, so a demographic or an availability clause counts as a plausibility anchor -- G2-SURG-01, G2-SURG-02; (2) correctness conditions are conjunction-only, so a disjunctive guideline indication is scored as unmet when one disjunct holds -- G2-PED-02; (3) an unassigned feature is scored unsatisfied, so silence is treated as defeat -- G2-PHELO-01, G2-PSY-03, and every 'That condition is not met here' clause; (4) nothing tests competitors against each other, so a redundant, nested or anchor-equals-condition competitor is admissible -- G2-MED-03, G2-SURG-01, G2-PED-01. This is the real next target, and it is upstream of both options and stems.
phase_9_root_cause_decision.why_not_difficulty_calibration: 0 of 8; difficulty is a consequence of the same substrate, not a separate cause.
phase_9_root_cause_decision.why_not_evidence_scoping: 0 of 8 as a primary; it appears once, inside G2-PED-02's matrix encoding.
phase_9_root_cause_decision.why_not_option_semantic_realization: 1 of 8. Distractor realization is verbatim in 32 of 32 and the single option-layer primary, G2-OBGYN-01, is the only rejection a perfect option layer would have prevented.
phase_9_root_cause_decision.why_not_option_set_parity: 0 of 8; parity is uniform by construction and cueing forced no rejection.
